test_title: PYST 32: SSC CHSL 2023 - English (Held On: 11 Aug, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.**

Meenakshi __called out for the neighbourhood__ to get support for her campaign.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Called around the neighbourhood.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The phrasal verb "**called around**" means to visit or contact a number of places or people in a particular area. (किसी विशेष क्षेत्र में अनेक स्थानों या लोगों से मिलना या उनसे संपर्क करना)

 
 
• **Example**: *Feeling lost in a new city, she decided to call around to different local businesses for recommendations on the best places to explore.*
 
 
 
• In this context of the given sentence, Meenakshi is seeking support from her neighbours in the surrounding area.
 
• The preposition "**around**" indicates the general vicinity of the neighbourhood.
 
• It is grammatically correct and conveys the intended meaning of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 4**.
